description: Rate limiting and funnel configuration for the acquisition stage. Locale (cc=us&l=english) is deliberately NOT a field here: ARCHITECTURE.md's Data Sources section locks it as a fixed, non-configurable acquisition-stage constant, so it is hard-coded as a module-level constant inside acquisition, not threaded through config.
signature:
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AcquisitionConfig:
    steamspy_page_delay_seconds: float
    steam_requests_per_minute: float
    max_retries: int
    backoff_base_seconds: float
    backoff_max_seconds: float
    request_budget: int
    coarse_filter: CoarseFilterCriteria
docstring:
Acquisition-stage tunables (ARCHITECTURE.md Data Sources / Rate limiting).

Attributes:
    steamspy_page_delay_seconds: Minimum delay between consecutive SteamSpy 'all' page requests.
    steam_requests_per_minute: Token-bucket refill rate for Steam Web API / storefront requests.
    max_retries: Bounded retry count for HttpClient on 5xx/timeout before marking a request failed.
    backoff_base_seconds: Initial exponential-backoff interval.
    backoff_max_seconds: Backoff interval ceiling.
    request_budget: Hard per-run request cap; RateLimiter.acquire raises RequestBudgetExceeded once spent, per ADR-004/006 'fail loudly rather than hammer the API'.
    coarse_filter: Nested CoarseFilterCriteria band.
postconditions: Instance is frozen; a single AcquisitionConfig is constructed once per run and shared by all acquisition clients

edge_cases.input: backoff_base_seconds > backoff_max_seconds in the TOML file
request_budget smaller than the expected candidate count for a typical run
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Not validated here (config has no knowledge of catalog size); acquisition.run_acquisition surfaces RequestBudgetExceeded at runtime instead

unit_tests.name: test_accepts_valid_fixture
unit_tests.description: A complete, valid AcquisitionConfig section round-trips through load_parameters unchanged.
unit_tests.expected: AcquisitionConfig instance with matching field values
